article.hook: A tiny mistake spirals into a dozen worst-case scenarios. You keep moving faster, sharper, because stopping means facing the feeling: you’re never quite enough. Lilith in Virgo locks us in this loop for months.
article.lived: Over the next nine months, watch how ‘fixing’ becomes a reflex. You rewrite the same email three times, triple-check every list, and volunteer for extra shifts without asking why. The clock runs, your to-do pile grows, and the quiet anxiety waits beneath every task, unspoken but palpable.
article.turn: The grit that fuels this work ethic can turn merciless. When every flaw inflates into disaster, you snap at colleagues, second-guess your every move, and burn out quietly while telling yourself it’s just ‘doing your part.’ Productivity stops being a tool and turns into a cage you build around yourself.
moves: Schedule one task and do only that, ignoring the rest until it’s done.
Ask a trusted person to name one thing you did well each day, no matter how small.
Write down your worst ‘what if’ thought and then list three facts that prove it false.
